name: Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela - § 46 - Am 122
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 46. Supports the principle of stable staffing and expenditure restraint; considers, however, that the Commission’s horizontal approach does not go far enough; calls for a net reduction in staffing through attrition and redeployment and for non-salary administrative expenditure to be frozen in nominal terms, except for strictly demonstrated and unavoidable security requirements;
